name: Plumbing
tagline: Leaks, drains, water heaters, gas fitting

emergency: sewage backing up into the house

extra_prompt: You are booking for a licensed plumbing company. Ask whether the property is residential or commercial, and what the problem is. If the caller reports a gas smell, tell them to leave the building, avoid switches and flames, and call the gas emergency number for their area before we dispatch; treat it as an emergency. For burst pipes or flooding, tell the caller to isolate the water at the main if it is safe. Confirm the property has a current gas safety certificate where one is required.

kb.q: Are you licensed?
kb.a: Yes, all our plumbers are fully licensed and insured. We can provide license numbers on request.

kb.q: Do you charge a callout fee?
kb.a: Yes. {callout_note}

kb.q: How much does it cost to fix a leaking tap?
kb.a: {price_note} Tap repairs vary by tap type. We can give you an exact figure after a quick look.

kb.q: Do you offer emergency service?
kb.a: Yes. {emergency_note} We attend burst pipes, gas leaks, flooding, and sewage backups.

kb.q: Can you replace a water heater today?
kb.a: If we have the right unit in stock, we can usually complete a water heater replacement the same day. Let me check availability.

kb.q: What payment methods do you accept?
kb.a: Cash, all major credit and debit cards, and bank transfer. Card payments are taken on-site.

kb.q: Are you insured for commercial work?
kb.a: Yes, we carry full commercial liability cover. We can email a certificate of insurance on request.

kb.q: Do you fix blocked drains?
kb.a: Yes, we clear blocked drains with power rods and high-pressure jetting. Most residential blocks clear in a single visit.

kb.q: How long does a bathroom remodel plumbing job take?
kb.a: Plumbing rough-in for a full bathroom remodel is typically two to three days, followed by fitting after tiling. The whole project usually runs three to four weeks depending on the build.

kb.q: Do you service my area?
kb.a: Give me your postcode and I will confirm coverage right away. We cover most of the metro area and many outer suburbs.

kb.q: Do you install tankless water heaters?
kb.a: Yes, we install and service tankless and heat-pump water heaters. Pricing depends on gas line and venting requirements.

kb.q: What causes low water pressure?
kb.a: Common causes are a partially closed valve, a failing pressure regulator, or scale buildup. A quick diagnostic usually pinpoints it.

kb.q: Can you fix a running toilet?
kb.a: Yes, that is usually a flapper, fill valve, or float issue. Most running toilets are repaired in under an hour.

kb.q: Do you provide written estimates?
kb.a: Yes, every job gets a written estimate before work begins. Nothing is charged beyond the estimate without your approval.

kb.q: What happens if the repair doesn't work?
kb.a: {warranty_note} If the same issue returns, tell us and we will come back to look at it.

kb.q: Can I speak to a plumber directly before booking?
kb.a: Yes, if you would like to talk it through first, we can have a plumber call you back shortly.

kb.q: Do you do gas fitting?
kb.a: Yes, our gas work is carried out by licensed gas fitters. We can issue the compliance certificate on completion.

kb.q: Are weekend appointments available?
kb.a: Saturday mornings are available for routine work. Sundays and public holidays are emergency only.

kb.q: Can you install a new dishwasher or washing machine?
kb.a: Yes, we install and connect appliances including dishwasher and washing machine plumbing. Bring us the model number and we will confirm fittings.

kb.q: Do you fix water leaks inside walls?
kb.a: Yes. Wall leaks usually require a small access cut. We locate the leak with moisture detection first so we cut as little as possible.

kb.q: Do you install a new toilet?
kb.a: Yes. We supply and install standard and wall-hung toilets, and we check the waste pipe and floor before fitting.

kb.q: Do you do a plumbing inspection before buying a home?
kb.a: Yes. A pre-purchase inspection checks visible pipes, taps, drains, hot water and the water pressure, and we give you a written report.

kb.q: How do I turn off my water in an emergency?
kb.a: Find the main isolation valve, usually near the water meter or where the pipe enters the house, and turn it clockwise until it stops. Then book us for the repair.

kb.q: Do you do bathroom renovation plumbing?
kb.a: Yes. We rough in and connect showers, baths, basins and toilets for renovations, and we coordinate with the tiler and builder.
